bulkAdd.help: Add multiple things from a CSV — or a ZIP with the photos included.
bulkAdd.formatIntro: Upload a CSV with a "headline" column (required). Optional columns: description, fee, availability, location, condition, tags (separate multiple tags with |), deposit (libraries only). The fee decides the verb: with a fee a stall sells and a library rents out, without one it gives away and lends. (A "type" column is still accepted, and has to agree with the fee.) To add photos, upload a ZIP with the CSV plus the image files and reference each photo by filename in a "photo" column. Extra photos (the carousel) go in a "photos" column, separated by | (up to 8 per thing).

bulkAdd.formatBody: Tags go in one cell separated by | (and must be defined in the collection — write the tag in any of its languages, e.g. "Crianza" or "Criança"). The fee and deposit columns both accept either 1.5 or 1,5, and deposit is only used for LEND/RENT rows — a value on any other type is rejected. requestInfo.label: Note before someone asks: at the top of the request page (optional)
requestInfo.helper: Shown at the top of the request page — seen by anyone requesting a loan, a rental or a reservation.

emailNote.label: Note in the emails after someone asks (optional)
emailNote.helper: Goes in the emails a member gets about their request, after the link to the thing, in their language. Markdown and emojis work.

kinds.chooseIntro: Choose what your things are for. The kind can't be changed later.

STALL.what: Things to sell or give away: whoever takes one keeps it.

LIBRARY.what: Things to lend or rent out: people take them home and bring them back.

SHED.what: Machines and spaces used where they are, booked by the day or by the hour.

collectionForm.membersPriceStall: Members can sell: Each member can set a price on their own things. Turn off so they can only give them away.
collectionForm.membersPriceLibrary: Members can rent out: Each member can set a price on what they lend. Turn off so they can only lend it for free.

thingPause.toggleLabel: Pause bookings: between these two dates nobody can request or book it; bookings already made are not cancelled.

thingPause.bookingsInRange_other: There are {{count}} bookings on those dates: they are not cancelled. You can cancel them from your bookings.

thingForm.unitsHelp: If you have several identical ones, they can be booked at the same time up to this number. Each person books one.
